svg.text: ARCHITECTURE 2.0 // THE 6-STAGE AI-NATIVE DESIGN LOOP X-RAY (MoonshotAI/nano-kpu)
"Everyone is staring at rtl/. They are looking at the wrong directory. The revolution is harness/—and the 3 Return Arrows from Interpret."
Layer 3 Cross-Stack Co-Design • 100 MHz Nangate45 • 16 B/cyc DRAM

g.text: • audit.py flags $fread shortcut OR fxmodel.py catches bit mismatch
Fix: Align msh_deq.v ((q-z)*s << 14) Q4.26 shift with fxmodel.py
RETURN ARROW B (Turn 2) → 2. EXPLORE [Microarchitectural / Elasticity / Area Fault]
• 2x DRAM latency overflows naive FIFO, randreset X-corrupts SRAM, & 16-way parallel demux adds +96K gates
Fix: Re-explore uArch → byte-serial beat emitter in msh_deq.v, credit FIFO + 256-cyc clr_active in msh_fetch.v
RETURN ARROW C (Turn 3) → 1. FORMULATE [System Roofline Wall — Triggers Layer 3 Cross-Stack Co-Design]
• Physics Wall: FP16 weights (304,448 B/tok) on 16 B/cyc DRAM require >=19,028 cyc/tok (max 5,255 tok/s) — impossible to hit >8,000 tok/s!
Fix: Reopen 1. FORMULATE → Co-design INT4 group-128 format (76,112 B/tok = 4,757 cyc floor) + zero-point fold Σ(q-z)x = Σqx - zΣx
